method: EPA register 'National Grid Reference' and application-form 'Site Centre Point (Irish Grid Reference - 6 digits)' read as EPSG:29903 (TM75 / Irish Grid) and transformed to WGS84 with pyproj 3.7.1, default operation 'Inverse of Irish Grid + TM75 to WGS 84 (2)' (stated accuracy 1 m); the alternative operation (3) moves each point by about 2 m. Read as ITM (EPSG:2157) both values would lie in the Atlantic several hundred kilometres south-west of Ireland (about 48.3-48.9 N, 11.7-12.1 W), so Irish Grid is the only plausible reading, as in the ie-p1 and ie-p2 EPA site-centre points. Cross-check distances are WGS84 geodesic distances (pyproj Geod, WGS84 ellipsoid) to points of the merged national planning register (IrishPlanningApplications feature service, outSR 4326) and the Department of Housing EIA Portal feature service, whose point derivations are undocumented, except where an ITM coordinate is printed in the record text.
